cases.translation: The work was new and useful.
cases.explain: «Дело» is the grammatical subject of «было», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.translation: They had just arrived from Moscow.
cases.explain: The preposition «из» governs the Genitive case: «из Москвы».

cases.sentence: Они только что приехали из Москвы и рады были своему ___.
cases.translation: They had just arrived from Moscow and were glad of their solitude.
cases.explain: The short adjective «рады» governs the Dative case (рад чему): «рады уединению».

cases.sentence: Он думал и писал, не переставая радостно чувствовать её ___.
cases.translation: He thought and wrote, never ceasing to feel her presence joyfully.
cases.explain: «Присутствие» is the direct object of the transitive verb «чувствовать», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: Занятия его и ___, и книгой не были оставлены им.
cases.translation: He had not abandoned his work with the estate and the book.
cases.explain: «Заниматься/занятия чем» takes the Instrumental case: «занятия хозяйством».

cases.sentence: Он сидел в ___ у письменного стола и писал.
cases.translation: He sat in his study at the writing desk and wrote.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» expressing location governs the Prepositional case: «в кабинете».

reading.ru: Они только что приехали из Москвы и рады были своему уединению.
reading.question: Why were Levin and Kitty especially glad at this point in the story?
options: They had just arrived from Moscow and were glad of their solitude together
They had just gotten married in Moscow
They were glad the harvest was good
reading.correct: They had just arrived from Moscow and were glad of their solitude together
reading.explain: The text says they had just arrived from Moscow and were glad of their solitude.

reading.ru: Она в том темно-лиловом платье, которое она носила первые дни замужества и нынче опять надела, и которое было особенно памятно и дорого ему, сидела на диване, на том самом кожаном старинном диване, который стоял всегда в кабинете у деда и отца Левина и шила «Бродери Англес» с французского «английской гладью».
reading.question: What was Kitty doing as she sat on the old leather sofa in Levin's study?
options: She was doing embroidery ('Broderie Anglaise') while wearing the dark lilac dress from the first days of her marriage
She was reading a French novel aloud
She was writing a letter to Dolly
reading.correct: She was doing embroidery ('Broderie Anglaise') while wearing the dark lilac dress from the first days of her marriage
reading.explain: She sat on the old leather sofa wearing her dark lilac dress and did 'Broderie Anglaise' embroidery.

reading.ru: Прежде дело это было для него спасением от жизни.
reading.question: What had Levin's work previously meant to him?
options: It had been a refuge, a salvation from life
It had been a source of great wealth
It had been forced on him by his father
It had been a way to impress Kitty
reading.correct: It had been a refuge, a salvation from life
reading.explain: The text says that formerly this work had been a salvation from life for him.

reading.ru: Он писал теперь новую главу о причинах невыгодного положения земледелия в России.
reading.question: What was the subject of the new chapter Levin was writing?
options: The causes of the disadvantageous state of agriculture in Russia
The history of the Shcherbatsky family
The proper way to raise children
reading.correct: The causes of the disadvantageous state of agriculture in Russia
reading.explain: He was now writing a new chapter on the causes of the disadvantageous state of agriculture in Russia.
